name: Studio critique and revision
scenario: A designer logs print and interaction projects. Established components make routine polish fast, while interpreting open-ended feedback can require several distinct design passes.

tasks.title: Tidy the type on the film calendar
tasks.description: Apply the existing type scale to dates, standardize three captions, and export the poster to PDF.
tasks.details: Edits are marked individually on the proof.

tasks.title: Rethink the building orientation screen
tasks.description: Use the last critique to propose two substantially different ways a visitor can identify their entrance. Test both as paper sketches before picking one.
tasks.details: The feedback concerns the order of decisions, not just styling.

sections.heading: Observed
sections.body: At the lobby prototype, visitors started the tour from the wrong wing because two entries share the same artwork. Several participants tapped the photograph before noticing the room name.

sections.heading: Redesign
sections.body: Develop two different entry decisions: one anchored in a landmark and one in a room label. Sketch both; keep the same available wall space and standard component library.

sections.heading: Critique board
sections.body: Show both alternatives, one reason each might fail, and the observation that led you to choose the final direction.

tasks.title: Prepare print files for the signage test
tasks.description: Export the approved variants at final size, add crop marks and inspect the type at print scale.
tasks.details: Production pass only; no design decisions remain.

tasks.title: Prepare a two-slide critique agenda
tasks.description: Pick two screenshots, state the open question under each and export for the weekly review.
tasks.details: Source file has both frames already.

tasks.title: Revise the pop-up menu after critique
tasks.description: Explore three content groupings and compare how first-time users find prices. Build two clickable variants and annotate the choice.
tasks.details: The client rejected the old grouping but has no preferred replacement.

tasks.title: Fix line breaks on the wall label
tasks.description: Apply eight explicit copy and spacing fixes from the annotated proof and regenerate the print PDF.
tasks.details: The print vendor supplied exact widths.

tasks.title: Choose accessible badge colors
tasks.description: Try palette alternatives and check contrast on the two surfaces until both pass; document the pair we select.
tasks.details: Have a starting palette. One contrast conflict still needs judgment.

tasks.title: Export tablet images for install
tasks.description: Export the signed-off screen variants at two resolutions and check the filenames against the install sheet.

holdouts.title: Take a second pass at the ticket kiosk
holdouts.description: Prepare a revision for critique after visitors missed the timed-entry option. The brief asks for competing approaches and a reasoned choice.
holdouts.details: We have accepted components but no accepted flow.

sections.heading: Field observation
sections.body: Four trial visitors selected general entry and discovered the timed exhibit only at checkout. On the current screen the time selector appears below the ticket count.

sections.heading: For critique
sections.body: Explore two genuinely different orders of decisions. Storyboard three frames per order and annotate where a first-time visitor sees the timed option. Use the supplied type and button components.

sections.heading: Handoff
sections.body: Bring both storyboards, a short rationale referencing the observation, and a list of open questions. Final icons and production exports will be assigned later.

holdouts.check: A request for two alternatives and a rationale should select open revision history, despite available components.

holdouts.title: Apply the signed-off kiosk edits
holdouts.description: Replace the old price string, align three labels to the baseline grid, and export the approved frames for install.
holdouts.details: All changes are specified; no additional alternatives are requested.
holdouts.check: Retrieve approved edits even though this export needed an extra revision. Check the downside of a large downward correction and whether the range covers the outcome.
